DialogEN.Text: What are you looking for this time?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player

DialogEN.Text: Well, not that I don't want to

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...You're not going to regret saying that, are you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see you in an hour!
